text_block_list.text:
The Junior Class with Symboli Kris S has 
concluded, and now the Classic Class—her 
year of challenge—is finally about to 
begin...!

While working alone in the Trainer's room, 
reviewing training plans and handling 
various tasks for the upcoming year—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Pardon me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――Happy New Year. ...Happy New Year to 
you.
choice_data_list: Happy New Year! ...What's in that bag?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"This is... A little while ago, when I 
stopped by the student council room—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—Still, it is quite courteous of you to 
come all the way to the student council 
room just to give New Year's greetings.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
At the start of the year—greetings are 
essential.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Tracen Academy treasures... A sense of the 
season. ...It values seasonal traditions.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Yes, the one who taught me that 
was—Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fufu— When in Rome, do as the Romans do... 
I suppose that's how it goes.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...By the way—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: What on earth is that—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I am preparing for the "first 
calligraphy of the year."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: I see—so this is... "Kakizome"—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
At Tracen Academy, the Student Council 
members often write down their goals and 
guidelines for the year. It's become a bit 
of a tradition.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Hm, this is a good opportunity. Kris S, 
care to give it a try too?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: A goal... a guiding principle...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
“—And so, from Rudolf... ink brush. —I 
borrowed the tools.”
choice_data_list:
Didn't you do it with Rudolf and the 
others?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. If I were to do... the first 
calligraphy of the new year—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"...Goals, guidelines— sharing them—is 
what you should do—with a Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: So—please, lend me a hand.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Words fitting for a goal, a guiding 
principleâfor me. ...Please, teach me 
those words.
choice_data_list: If that's the case, got it!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――Thanks.

If I were to write something together with 
Symboli Kris S, the content would be—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Always, victorious...—
choice_data_list:
It means always winning, no matter what 
kind of race it is.

It means winning every single race, no 
matter what kind it is.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I see—invincibility. A strength that 
defies common sense— Fitting... for one 
such as myself who strives for it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――OK. Then――I will write this.

"Inscribing our goals into calligraphy— 
and so, the Classic Year kicks off!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――Health comes first. Indeed, it is 
important. ...Very much so.
choice_data_list:
It's precisely because we're taking on a 
challenge that we need to focus on the 
fundamentals

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Yeah. —Then I'll write this down.

Writing down what must be cherished in 
calligraphy— the Classic Year was 
officially underway!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Stay... calm...——
choice_data_list:
Basically, you're the same Kris S as 
always.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: The usual...?

...Symboli Kris S's strength lies in the 
overwhelming stability and composure of 
her mind.

I explained that I chose "composure" as a 
reminder never to forget that strength.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Strengths. ...I see. The basics... that 
one must never forget. A guiding 
principle, perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――OK. Then――I will write this.

"Inscribing in calligraphy what must never 
be forgotten— thus begins the Classic 
year!"
